title: Visa documentation executive
description:
Job Summary:

We are looking for a detail\-oriented Visa Documentation Executive to handle end\-to\-end visa documentation and application coordination for clients traveling internationally. The role involves collecting and verifying documents, preparing visa files, coordinating with clients and visa centers, and ensuring applications meet embassy/consulate requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

1\.Collect and review client documents according to embassy/consulate requirements.

2\.Prepare and organize visa application files for Schengen, UK,and other countries.

3\.Verify passports, bank statements, employment documents, travel insurance, hotel bookings, flight itineraries, invitation letters, NOCs, cover letters, and supporting documents.

4\. Identify missing, inconsistent, or incorrect information and coordinate with clients to rectify them.

5\. Prepare professional cover letters, invitation letters, NOC letters, itineraries, explanation letters, and document checklists.

6\.Complete visa application forms accurately and cross\-check information before submission.

7\.Coordinate VFS, BLS, TLS, embassy/consulate appointments, biometrics, and document submission where applicable.

8\.Maintain client records, application status, deadlines, and document tracking. Follow up with clients regarding pending documents and visa decisions.

9\.Stay updated on changes in embassy/consulate visa rules and documentation requirements.

10\.Coordinate with internal sales and operations teams to ensure smooth processing.

11\.Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of client information. Handle multiple applications simultaneously while meeting submission deadlines.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Content Writing Intern
description:
2Base Technologies is at a deliberate stage of building its marketing content function, and this internship is the entry point into that function.  
We are a technology services company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working with mid\-market and enterprise clients across the United States and the United Kingdom. Our work spans custom software development, AI implementation, legacy system modernisation, and operational transformation.  
This is an entry\-level writing role with a specific, practical purpose. It is not a social media role and it is not a generalist marketing role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.

What This Role Exists to Do  
Technology is complicated. Our job is to make it clear. This role exists to support the production of written content that explains what 2Base does, what problems we solve, and why that matters to the people we work with. The output is blog posts that earn attention, social copies that are actually read, and supporting content that helps the marketing function move.  
You will work from structured briefs, receive direct feedback on every draft, and build a practical foundation in technology content writing. The audience is technical leaders and business decision\-makers at mid\-market companies. Writing that is clear, specific, and free of noise. That is the standard you will be working towards and learning to meet.

What You Will Own  
First drafts of blog posts on technology topics including software development, AI implementation, digital transformation, and IT services written from structured briefs provided by the Marketing Manager  
Social media copies for the 2Base LinkedIn page and other channels, produced to brief and reviewed before publishing  
Research for content briefs – gathering background, understanding the topic, and returning with enough substance to write from  
Supporting long\-form content production: contributing sections, drafts, and revisions under direction  
Proofreading and editing your own drafts against 2Base brand voice guidelines before submitting

What You Will Not Own  
Content strategy and editorial planning: the Marketing Manager sets the direction and you execute within it  
Publishing decisions: a separate team member manages scheduling and publishing  
Visual design of content assets: the design function owns this  
SEO keyword selection: the SEO specialist sets this and you write within it  
Campaign strategy or audience definition  
Client\-facing communications of any kind

Requirements  
Experience  
Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience. Internship experience in content writing, copywriting, journalism, or technical writing counts.  
Has written something anything that demonstrates the ability to put ideas into clear, readable sentences. College submissions, personal blogs, LinkedIn posts, college magazine articles, or internship work all qualify.  
Has used AI writing tools and understands both their value and their limits. AI is a tool in this role, not the writer.  
Background in engineering, computer science, or information technology is preferred. Graduates from other streams with demonstrated interest in technology topics are also considered.

Writing Ability  
Writes clearly in English. Not without errors that improves with practice – but with a clear structure and a readable point.  
Can read a brief and produce something that addresses it, rather than writing whatever comes to mind  
Accepts feedback and revises drafts without treating the edit as personal criticism  
Does not pad. Does not repeat the same point in different words to fill length.

Mindset  
Genuinely curious about technology topics: not faking interest to get the job, but actually reading and thinking about what software, AI, and digital infrastructure do in the real world  
Comfortable not knowing things and asking questions before writing rather than guessing  
Fast enough to produce a first draft within a day of receiving a brief, knowing it will be edited  
Treats writing as a skill to develop, not a talent they either have or do not have

What We Are Not Looking For  
Candidates who cannot write a coherent paragraph in English independently  
Candidates whose primary interest is social media management, graphic design, or video content, who see this as the nearest available opening  
Candidates who use AI tools as the primary author with only light editing and no independent writing ability  
Candidates who expect senior\-level scope, autonomy, or compensation from Day 1  
Candidates who apply without reading the role description and do not include a writing sample

An Honest Note on This Role  
This role joins a marketing function that is still building. You will not step into a well\-established content operation. You will work within a documented brand voice and a defined content direction, but the volume, pace, and iteration rhythm are things you will grow into alongside the team.

If you want to start a career in technology content writing and you are prepared to put in the work to learn how a B2B technology company communicates with senior buyers, this is a structured entry point. If you are looking for a creative writing role or a social media job, it is not.

To apply: send your CV and one writing sample. A blog post, a college article, a LinkedIn post, or anything else you have written that shows us how you think. If you do not have a writing sample, write 200 words on any technology topic that interests you and send it with your application. Send to: talents@2basetechnologies.com
